decision_reason: The observation was flagged as a low stored value by the supplementary IQR screen within the Posaconazole–ethanol–ethyl acetate system. Visual inspection showed that it appeared consistent with the surrounding composition trend at the same temperature, rather than forming an isolated deviation. The observation was retained because the statistical flag and visual review did not establish a measurement error. Its accuracy has not been independently confirmed against the original experimental source.
